_comment: Interior kit parts, first version (step 3 of the author's kit brief, 26. 9. 2026). One entry per part family; 'variants' are letters A..C, 'sizes' module lengths (m) and 'sections' the kit sections it exists for (kit_rules.json). Batches are built and approved in order (step 4); 'status': planned | built | approved. Names follow kit_rules naming: SM_Kit_<Category>_<Part><size dm><section>_<Variant>. Human-readable list: .claude/skills/ship-interior/SKILL.md, 'Interiérový kit: seznam dílů'.

Critic round 1 fixes: C with an L-track (holes, two anchors with D rings, a strap), coloured cables in the tray, a weaker cove; the wide ceilings' down-lights 50 deg / 260 cd, halo lights, wall washers and a service run; C with a grab handle and a container power outlet. 30. 9. 2026: 06L_D (flush plinth, where the hull closes in at the floor), ceilings Ceiling_Panel12L38_A/_C; the Wayfarer's cabin
Wall_HullLiner.pilot_needs: the Wayfarer's hold needs 8 SCU (2.5 m) plus a 1.25 m aisle = 3.75 m, but the widest W-profile room the hull takes there is 3.0 m (hull_fit_wayfarer.png): with the kit's 0.2 m wall structure the hold cannot be built from W walls as designed - a thin hull liner, or 6 SCU / a narrower aisle (author's decision).
